A creature made of stone  metal  or other inorganic material has disadvantage on its saving throw. Unattended objects in the area also take the damage."}, {"name": "Hypnotic Pattern (3rd-Level; S, M, Concentration)", "desc": "A swirling pattern of light appears at a point within 120 feet.
